title: Assessing Antibody-Mediated Phagocytosis of Lymphoma Cells by Macrophages In Vitro
author: Beielstein, Blakemore, et al.

steps.title: Produce murine feeder media
steps.instruction: Plate L‑929 fibroblasts on a 10 cm dish in non‑supplemented RPMI‑1640; when dense, replace with fresh RPMI, incubate, and collect conditioned media after 1 week (feeder media 1) and after 3 weeks (feeder media 2). Centrifuge each collection 5 min at 300 g, 20 °C, transfer supernatant to a new tube and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Collect murine progenitor cells
steps.instruction: Sacrifice mice, dissect femurs and flush each with 5 mL non‑supplemented DMEM. Centrifuge 360 g for 8 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, lyse erythrocytes with 2 mL ACK buffer for 2 min, stop with 50 mL cold PBS, centrifuge 300 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend pellet in 20 mL DMEM + 10 % FCS + 1 % Pen‑Strep, incubate 24 h on two 10 cm plates, then collect non‑adherent cells and count.

steps.title: Differentiate murine monocytes
steps.instruction: Plate 6 × 10⁵ cells/mL (5 mL) in DMEM + 10 % FCS + 1 % Pen‑Strep on a 10 cm plate, add 750 µL feeder 1 and 750 µL feeder 2, incubate 2 days. Add 4 mL DMEM + 10 % FCS + 1 % Pen‑Strep, 750 µL feeder 1, 750 µL feeder 2 and 50 ng M‑CSF (final 14.4 µM), incubate 4 days. Replace with 10 mL DMEM + 10 % FCS + 1 % Pen‑Strep, incubate 1 day, wash once with PBS, detach adherent macrophages by scraping and use immediately. After plating for the assay, incubate macrophages 24 h for recovery before ADCP.

steps.title: Produce human feeder media
steps.instruction: Plate L‑929 fibroblasts on a 10 cm dish in non‑supplemented RPMI‑1640; when dense, replace with fresh RPMI, incubate, and collect conditioned media after 1 week (feeder media 1) and after 3 weeks (feeder media 2). Centrifuge 5 min at 300 g, 20 °C, transfer supernatant and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs from buffy coats
steps.instruction: Add 15 mL Lymphoprep to a 50 mL SepMate tube, dilute buffy coat 1:1 with sterile DPBS (20 °C), layer 20 mL diluted buffy coat on top, centrifuge 1200 g for 15 min at 20 °C, harvest the top layer, wash cells three times with 50 mL DPBS (centrifuge 300 g, 8 min, 4 °C), resuspend in 12 mL cold MACS buffer, transfer to a 15 mL tube, centrifuge 300 g for 8 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 200 µL CD14‑microbeads and 800 µL MACS buffer, perform magnetic separation on a MacsQuant X (Miltenyi CD14 protocol), and resuspend CD14⁺ cells immediately in non‑supplemented RPMI‑1640.

steps.title: Differentiate monocytes to M2‑macrophages
steps.instruction: Plate 1 × 10⁶ CD14⁺ cells in 2 mL non‑supplemented RPMI‑1640 per well of a 12‑well plate. Add 10 ng/mL M‑CSF (final 0.2 nM) on day 1, day 3 and day 5 without changing medium. On day 7 scrape cells, use for experiments, and incubate 24 h for recovery before ADCP.

steps.title: Expand macrophage cell lines
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen macrophage stock, plate on a Corning 10 cm dish in 10 mL appropriate media (see Table 1) and let expand ≥1 week to recover. If confluence exceeds 80 %, split cells keeping ≥1 × 10⁴ cells/mL. Verify cell morphology microscopically; ensure good condition before ADCP.

steps.title: Expand lymphoma cells
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen lymphoma cell stock, plate on a 10 cm dish in 10 mL appropriate media (see Table 1), and let expand ≥3 days to recover before co‑culture.

steps.title: Prepare treatment dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the treatment compound in macrophage media to a final volume of 25 µL per well (minimum five replicates = 10 wells per condition). Prepare two additional dilutions (1/2 and 1/10 of the original concentration).

steps.title: Prepare antibody solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the appropriate antibody in macrophage media to 25 µL per well for half of the co‑culture wells (see Table 3 for concentrations: Alemtuzumab 10 µg/mL for J774A.1; Daratumumab 10 µg/mL for primary human or murine macrophages).
